methods.label: Resonant breathing at 5.5-6 breaths/min
methods.prior_source: Lehrer & Gevirtz 2014 (Front Psychol): resonance-frequency HRV biofeedback, robust baroreflex effects

methods.label: Implementation intentions, WOOP
methods.prior_source: Gollwitzer & Sheeran 2006 (Adv Exp Soc Psychol): meta-analysis of 94 studies, d ~ 0.65

methods.label: Mental rehearsal, first person
methods.prior_source: Driskell, Copper & Moran 1994 (J Appl Psychol): mental practice meta-analysis, moderate effect, decays without physical practice

methods.label: Focusing, yoga nidra, self-hypnosis
methods.prior_source: Flammer & Bongartz 2003 (Contemp Hypn) and Hendricks 2002 (Focusing review): small-N studies, mixed quality

methods.label: Binaural and isochronic tones
methods.prior_source: Garcia-Argibay et al. 2019 (Psychol Res): binaural beats meta-analysis, small and unreliable effects
